herne-bay.title: Keeping a villa roofline
herne-bay.summary: Roofing Industries describes a Lowndes reroof using its corrugated profile on a low-pitch section.
herne-bay.lesson: A profile-specific solution can matter more than a generic material category. This case does not establish a minimum pitch for every corrugated roof.

hibiscus-coast.title: A two-day long-run replacement
hibiscus-coast.summary: HDK reports a two-day reroof with Trim Rib, new flashings and timber strengthening.
hibiscus-coast.lesson: This is one reported job duration, not a promise for a different house.

tauranga-reroof.title: Replacement with associated upgrades
tauranga-reroof.summary: Coldrick describes roughly a week of roofing work, with sarking, insulation and rainwater upgrades.
tauranga-reroof.lesson: Two reroof totals are not comparable until the associated work is matched.

tamahere-house.title: Damage uncovered under the old roof
tamahere-house.summary: Gerard describes replacing asphalt roofing and dealing with damaged plywood and framing beneath it.
tamahere-house.lesson: Hidden substrate work belongs in a contingency and variation process, not an assumed fixed removal rate.

eel-house.title: Curved architectural roofing
eel-house.summary: Dimond describes curved aluminium roofing over plywood, installed by The Roofing Smiths.
eel-house.lesson: Metal choice, curve geometry and support build-up all need to be specified before comparing tray prices.

ebbinge-house.title: Roof and cladding designed together
ebbinge-house.summary: Dimond documents coordinated roof and wall detailing, including recessed openings and integrated gutters.
ebbinge-house.lesson: Architectural pricing can include detailing far beyond laying roof pans.

whitby-access.title: One scaffold serving several trades
whitby-access.summary: Erect It describes access for roofing, recladding and window work on the same property.
whitby-access.lesson: Hire duration should follow all trades using the scaffold, not just the roofing crew.

kennedys-bush.title: Different roofs on one new home
kennedys-bush.summary: Steel & Tube describes Coughlan Homes using Sandstone Grey Custom Orb on pitched areas and a membrane system on flat areas. The account also identifies extra-high-wind detailing.
kennedys-bush.lesson: A single house can need multiple systems. Do not apply a corrugated rate to every surface without checking the roof plan.

kings-brooklyn.title: Working around a hillside site
kings-brooklyn.summary: Kings Roofing reports a June 2025 reroof involving difficult access, scaffolding, removal and new flashings as well as the roof sheets.
kings-brooklyn.lesson: The new covering is only part of the cost. Compare access and flashing scope before comparing total prices.

island-bay.title: A coastal specification in context
island-bay.summary: Element Roofing identifies an Ebony corrugated reroof close to the coast in its 2021 account. Redundant rooftop items were removed during the work.
island-bay.lesson: A dated project helps explain exposure-driven specification. Obtain current coating and warranty advice rather than copying an old product name.

element-brooklyn.title: Corrugate above, another profile below
element-brooklyn.summary: Element Roofing describes replacing an asbestos-cement roof in 2021. Corrugate was used on the upper roof and MC760 on the shallower lower section.
element-brooklyn.lesson: Roof material identification and pitch both affect the scope. An attractive corrugated upper roof does not establish suitability on its low-pitch extension.

central-terrace.title: Coordinating roof and exterior work
central-terrace.summary: The Central Terrace account describes corrugated roofing with rainwater work and scaffolding also used for painting.
central-terrace.lesson: A shared scaffold package can blur the apparent roof price. Ask how common access costs are allocated between trades.
